title: The Evidence Protocol
subtitle: A learning escape room about decisions under uncertainty
briefing: An urgent recommendation is about to be sent without a full review. Enter the briefing room, examine the evidence, and restore the decision process before time runs out. Every clue has a purpose. Every assumption needs a check.
learningGoals:
Distinguish evidence from assumptions.
Check information before taking action.
Evaluate a decision before committing to it.
debrief:
What information did you initially assume was true?
How did checking the evidence change your decisions?
Where does your team need a stronger verification step?

scenes.name: The briefing room
scenes.description: Inspect the file, unlock the case, and find your way into the lab.

objects.name: Evidence summary
objects.body:
A sound recommendation needs a clear trail of evidence.

4 corroborated sources
3 unanswered questions
1 proposed action

The case code follows that order: sources, questions, action.
hints: Inspect the evidence folder on the desk.

objects.name: Evidence case
objects.body: A three-digit code protects the verification key. Use the figures in the evidence summary, in the order shown.
objects.success: Case unlocked. The verification key is now on the desk.
hints: Inspect the folder on the desk.
Count the sources, questions, and action—in that order.

objects.name: Verification key
objects.body: A brass key marked VERIFY. Use it on the lab door.

objects.name: Lab door
objects.body: The evidence lab is locked. Find the verification key.
objects.success: The key fits. Welcome to the evidence lab.
hints: Unlock the evidence case to find the key.
Drag the key to this door, or select it and then click the door.

scenes.name: The evidence lab
scenes.description: Assemble the containment unit, then evaluate the next step.

objects.name: Assembly instructions
objects.body:
Uncontrolled information can spread before it is tested. Assemble the containment unit before reading its results.

Fit the round lid onto the open container. You can drag it directly from the workbench.

objects.name: Container lid
objects.body: A round lid with a secure handle. It fits the open containment unit.

objects.name: Containment unit
objects.body: This unit needs its lid before the results can be read.
objects.success: The lid is fitted. A result card is now available.
hints: Find the loose lid on the workbench.
Drag the lid over this container.

objects.name: Result card
objects.body:
A decision process is only as strong as the review before action.

Before committing, EVALUATE the evidence: its quality, relevance, and limits.

Enter the emphasized word into the review panel.

objects.name: Review panel
objects.body: Enter the action you should take before committing to a consequential decision.
objects.success: Review passed. The command room is available.
hints: Read the result card revealed on the workbench.

objects.name: Command room door
objects.body: The review panel must be cleared before you can enter.

scenes.name: Mission control
scenes.description: Make the final decision and restore the evidence protocol.

objects.name: Final decision brief
objects.body:
An unconfirmed report has just arrived. It supports the recommendation, but there is no second source.

Your options: ACT immediately, IGNORE the report, or VERIFY the information.

The protocol requires evidence before commitment. Type the best next action into the release panel.

objects.name: Release panel
objects.body: What should you do with the unconfirmed report before taking action?
objects.success: Evidence protocol restored. Your team can now make a supported decision.
hints: Choose the action that checks the unconfirmed report.
